prompt: Some people think that schools should focus on teaching academic subjects that will help students pass exams. Others believe that schools should also teach practical skills, such as how to manage money and cook food. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people believe that governments should spend more money on public education and measures to prevent illness, rather than on treating people who are already sick. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people believe that individuals can do little to improve the environment and only governments and large corporations can make a difference. Others think that the actions of individuals are essential in protecting the environment. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people think that universities should focus on providing graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think that the true function of a university should be to give access to knowledge for its own sake, regardless of whether the course is useful to an employer. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people believe that increasing the price of fuel is the best way to solve growing environmental problems. Others think that other measures would be more effective. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people believe that the widespread use of smart devices in everyday life is making people more socially isolated. Others argue that technology actually helps to bring people closer together. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people believe that secondary school students should be required to study science subjects. Others think that students should be free to choose the subjects they prefer. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people believe that traditional museums and art galleries are no longer needed because people can view historical objects and artworks on the internet. Others, however, think that physical museums and galleries still play an important role in society. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people think that secondary school students should be allowed to choose all the subjects they study. Others believe that they should study a wide range of compulsory subjects regardless of their preferences. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many countries, more and more people are choosing to live alone rather than with family members. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

In recent years, many universities have started offering degrees that can be completed entirely online, without the need for students to attend lectures on campus. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Some people think that secondary school students should study a wide range of subjects. Others believe that they should focus on a limited number of subjects in which they have a special interest or talent. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people think that universities should only accept students who achieve the highest academic results. Others believe that everyone should have the right to a university education, regardless of their grades. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many countries, an increasing number of people are using mobile phone applications to monitor their daily health and fitness. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Some people think that universities should focus on preparing students for their future careers by teaching practical skills. Others believe that the primary purpose of a university should be to provide a broad academic education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
